notes.title: 0.9.0 Released
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]

[list]
[*]  Coop mode (resurrection at next unlocked station, separate save file, Remote Play Together support)
[*]  Electron weapons and drone
[*]  Drone modules now have maximum drone count
[*]  Drones now don't have timeout
[*]  Drones get destroyed when the module is uninstalled
[*]  Piercing projectiles
[*]  Biomes now have layers
[*]  New music system
[*]  New pathfinding system
[*]  Vault now can be scrolled
[*]  Units reworked
[*]  Enemies are now startled when shot
[*]  Improved pixel art shader to avoid aliasing
[*]  SFX system improvements
[*]  New music and SFX
[*]  Resource pickup movement improvements
[*]  Improved light propagation calculation
[*]  No disabled or boosted module slot around ship, weapons and gadgets slots
[*]  Burning simulation is optimized and now runs every frame
[*]  Run duration is saved and displayed on the pause menu
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]  Fixed occasional crash on game restart
[*]  Fixed usage cost not shown for weapons and gadgets
[*]  Fixed occasional infinite gamepad rumble in menus
[*]  Fixed button hints sometimes not following input device change
[*]  Fixed log messages not disappearing on menu screens
[*]  Removed player - drone collision
[*]  Fixed stations sometimes buried in slime blocks
[*]  Fixed some secrets not loading in a saved game
[*]  Rocket sound now stops after impact
[*]  Probably a bunch of others we forgot
[/list]

notes.title: 0.8.0 Released
notes.content:
New level structure
- 3 bosses in 3 different biomes (all bosses are the same for now)
- Biome generation is reworked and are more compact, should feel like parts of the world
- Subbiom generation reworked
- We now have a system for generating mini-dungeons, but so far pretty limited content-wise
Modules are now organized into clusters (passive, primary and secondary weapons, 1 for each active module)
- By default all main modules (Ship, Weapons and Active modules) have a 3x3 cluster around them
- Modules are considered powered if they are inside of the cluster
- Clusters can be expanded by adding power cores
- All main modules have a random power level indicating the # of power cores it can support
- Cluster cannot overlap, so players need to think about how to lay them
Weapon augmentations work for weapon based active modules
Passive modules and weapon modifier support for drones
At the start of every run players can choose a starter loadout
New enemy
Booster module only works if connected and powered
Improved background generation
Cells shake when shot
Weapons and active modules are easier to place on the grid
Level generation time reduced by ~50%
Various improvements and bug fixes

notes.title: 0.7.0 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*] We added the first (of probably many) elemental effect to the game: fire!
     - You can set blocks and enemies on fire
     - Every block type has different heat propagation properties (how easily it catches on fire, how fast fire spreads from one block to another)
     - Fire propagation is simulated for the whole map, so you can set things on fire and leave the area to burn!
[*] Save and continue
     - Quitting the game saves your current run and you can continue from the where you left
     - This feature can break for a lot of reasons. If the game fails to load your save, please zip and send us the contents of the folder C:\Users\<username>\AppData\LocalLow\DefaultCompany\Punk\saves\save001 before starting a new run.
[*] There are now pipes running between stations that can help you find new stations
[*] New (hard) biome
[*] New weapon type: rocket, flamethrower
[*] New enemies, weapons, modules
[*] Gameplay balancing (early game is easier + lot of weapons became more viable)
[*] Visual upgrades
     - Sway animation for plants
     - Wider field of view
     - Tile shader improvements
     - Lighting tweaks
[*] Boost ability can be initiated more reliably
[*] Performance optimizations (you can expect better GPU and CPU performance as well). Please let us know how many FPS you got on what hardware (you can turn off V-sync in the main menu so it's not capped)
[*] Faster level generation
[*] UI should look better on larger screens
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]
